column1: # tests run with --test-threads=1, through a recording wrapper around AY: every
# resident-server window (`ay --incremental`; the plugin sends body, then
# (echo "==TCG_SRV_n=="), then (reset)) and every strict one-shot query file
# (body, then (exit)). Each <id>.smt2 is one body, byte-exact minus that framing;
# id = first 12 hex digits of sha256(body). Two captures (AY build 8256 and AY
# expected = the verdict of the body alone in a fresh session. Measured identical
# columns: id<TAB>expected<TAB>external-codegen obligation name(s), "-" when the trace
# run did not reach that body
